scope: 20 cold boots on the final layout with installed kernel r14 (plan section 2.1 step 9 / phase 9)
criteria: new boot ID; full power-off first (PON warm-reset reason 0); systemd running; taint 0; no failed units; root /dev/mmcblk0p35; both remoteprocs running; sound card 'LG Fx0' present; microSD present or absent as arranged

triggers.note: with USB connected the PMIC powers the phone back on right after shutdown (PON_REASON1 0x10); the owner's power-key boot with USB unplugged (cycle 19) reported PON_REASON1 0x01 (hard-reset bit) rather than KPDPWR

microsd: cycle 19 booted normally without a card (sd absent); cycles 1-18 and 20 with the card present
cycle_log: local harness local/cold-boot-run.py; one JSON line per cycle (private)
open: investigate why a power-key boot reports PON hard-reset (0x01) instead of KPDPWR (0x80)
